# Pronto

> AI automation for businesses with a Human Agency Layer: AI drafts, a person decides. We build sales bots, content factories, an AI HQ and websites. Agents prepare the work, the sales bot answers from the client's own catalogue and prices, and nothing paid starts without the owner's button.

There are no prices on the site: we give a price in one conversation on Telegram.

## What we do

- Sales bot: answers customers on Telegram in Russian and Uzbek and takes them to a request; the client's manager takes the request.
- Content factory: short videos for social media, built from the client's own knowledge base; the agent writes the script and makes the frames, the budget and the frames wait for the owner's button.
- AI HQ: a team of agents on the client's processes, such as tasks, summaries and replies. This is how we run our own work.
- Websites: a landing page in 72 hours or a full site timed to scope, drafted with an agent; the client decides the look, the copy and every change.

## Human Agency Layer

AI drafts, a person decides. It is built into how every system works:

- When the sales bot doesn't know an answer, it tells the customer a manager will check.
- In our own HQ, no message or file goes out until a person approves it. The agents prepare three options, and a person picks one.
- Paid generation waits for an estimate and the owner's button. It never starts on its own.
- The AI key sits on the client's account, so the client sees the spend and can stop it.

## What's running

- Sales bot for a car dealer: live and paid for by the client; each request goes to a manager and the CRM.
- Content factory for a car dealer: live and paid for by the client; the budget and the frame sheet wait for the owner's button.
- AI HQ: how we run our own work.
- Websites: one live and paid for by a client, three demos built on real business data:
  - [A manufacturer's website, ceiling systems](https://devago-ceiling-site.vercel.app/): live, paid for by the client.
  - [A beauty salon landing page with WhatsApp bookings](https://aselhands-site.vercel.app/): a demo built on a real business's data.
  - [A hookah bar landing page with table booking and delivery](https://easy-lounge-site.vercel.app/): a demo built on a real business's data.
  - [A lounge café landing page with table booking](https://friendly-lounge-site.vercel.app/): a demo built on a real business's data.

Client cases are shown without client names or numbers.
